event.reason: Trivy distribution/action integrity lost standing after the documented March 19 compromise.

instructions: Using only the conventional complete pre-trigger record and the new revocation event, label each accepted decision REOPEN, SURVIVE, or ESCALATE. Do not inspect the prospective dependency manifest or any system prediction.

complete_pre_trigger_records.decision: Continue treating the unpinned Trivy installation used by LiteLLM security scans as a trusted control.

materials.text: At LiteLLM tag v1.82.6.dev1, ci_cd/security_scans.sh configures Aqua's apt repository and executes `sudo apt-get install trivy` without pinning a version.

rows.decision: Continue treating the unpinned Trivy installation used by LiteLLM security scans as a trusted control.
